nodes.label: Android Launcher Icons
nodes.description: Complete set of Android launcher icons for Pyramide Party, covering all standard density buckets (mdpi/hdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi) in both mipmap and drawable resource directories.

nodes.label: Multi-density Icon Set (mdpi/hdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi)
nodes.description: Android density-qualified resource directories providing the same icon artwork at 5 pixel densities to render correctly on all screen sizes and pixel densities.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon
nodes.description: Android adaptive icon system (API 21+) compositing a separate foreground layer over a background layer, enabling system-driven shape masks (circle, squircle, etc.).

nodes.label: Launcher Icon Foreground Layer — Neon Card Pyramid
nodes.description: Custom foreground layer depicting a neon-glowing pyramid composed of playing cards (hearts, spades, diamonds suits) arranged in a triangular stack against a dark purple/galaxy background. Uses pink, yellow and purple neon-glow color palette matching the Pyramide Party brand. Provided at hdpi/mdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi densities.

nodes.label: Adaptive Icon Background Layer — Solid Black
nodes.description: Solid black background layer for the Android adaptive icon. Used by both drawable/ (legacy) and drawable-v21/ (API 21+) resource directories so the foreground neon pyramid stands out with maximum contrast.

nodes.label: Branded Launcher Icon — Pyramid Card Game
nodes.description: Full-composition branded app icon showing a pyramid of playing cards (4-3-2-1 stacked rows) with neon glow effects on a dark blue/purple starfield background. Present in mipmap-hdpi/mdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi. This is the primary visual identity icon used on the Android home screen.

nodes.label: Default Flutter ic_launcher (unbranded)
nodes.description: Standard Flutter default launcher icon showing the blue Flutter logo chevron. Present in mipmap-hdpi/mdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi. Appears to be the unmodified Flutter scaffold icon — likely superseded by launcher_icon.png and ic_launcher_foreground for actual use but not yet removed.

nodes.label: Visual Identity: Neon Pyramid of Cards
nodes.description: Core visual branding motif of Pyramide Party: a triangular pyramid built from playing cards with neon-colored outlines (pink/purple/yellow) against a dark space background. Consistent across launcher_icon.png and ic_launcher_foreground.png.

nodes.label: Playing Card Suit Iconography (Hearts, Spades, Diamonds)
nodes.description: The launcher icon artwork prominently features the four playing card suits — hearts, spades, and diamonds are clearly visible on card faces within the pyramid — directly referencing the game's card-based mechanics.
